cadences.hackathon: always due, no time limit: each run works issue after issue until the board is empty or PAUSE is set. Warning: the Mac and the model bill run without a ceiling; say so to the owner when switching a project to it

_runway.skillsNote: The only skills a Runway run may invoke, by name under ~/.claude/skills. The owner edits this list; a run never adds to it, and an improve entry naming a skill outside it is skipped and reported.
_runway.sourcesNote: The only outside pages the learn pass may read to widen a skill. Matching rule: parse the URL; scheme must be https, host must equal the listed host exactly (no suffix or substring match), no user info, no port, and the path must start with the listed path, which ends in a slash. A redirect that leaves the listed origin and path stops the read. Search, playground, profile and user-content paths are outside every entry. The pull request lists every URL fetched. The owner edits this list. A rule taken from one is marked external, cites page and date, and never overrides a rule the owner stated.
_runway.note: Entries with loop true are run by runway/dispatcher.md when their cadence is due, one after another; see runway/README.md. Keys a loop project needs: name, githubRepo, repoPath, linearTeamId, linearProject, statusIssue, checks, port, minutes, cadence, loop.

harness.description: Hooks, rules, templates and the self-improve tools behind every Claude session on this Mac. Routine only: doctor, then tune proposals as a pull request
harness.securityScope: runway-board/runway/*.md and projects.json, ~/.claude/hooks, ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/*/SKILL.md, every registered project's Lessons document and the week's run comments: injection paths, commands a run could be talked into, writes outside the allowed paths; findings as proposal files, never fixes in place

claude-skills.name: Design skills
claude-skills.description: The design skill set in ~/.claude/skills, named in focus. Routine only: those skills pass the skill-authoring checker and get the week's corrections; the rest of the library is not touched
checks: python3 skill-authoring/check.py ui-taste ui-screen ui-typo ds-policy design-harness grain-ui figma-exec figma-naming writing-taste
claude-skills.focusNote: The exact skills this routine may check and change; nothing outside the list. The owner edits it.
